Kṣitigarbhasūtra
Bud. Q. in Śikṣāsamuccaya, p.. 13, 67, 88, 100, 176 Bendall's edn.

Kṣitigarbhāṣṭottaraśatakanāmadhāraṇī_Mantrasaṃhitā
Bud. Lalou p. 90.
See the previous.

Kṣitigarbhāṣṭottaraśatanāma
Bud. AMG. II. p. 327. AR.

Kṣitipa
poet. Prasannasāhityaratnākara of Nandana (Kṣitīśa's in Subhāṣitaratnakośa 758).

Kṣitisūtra
Bud. Q. in the Śikṣāsamuccaya of Śāntideva, Cambr. Uni. Bud. p. 107.
See Kṣitigarbhasūtra.

Kṣitīśa
poet. Skm. p. 241; Subhāṣitaratnakośa 758. (Kṣitipa in Prasannasāhityaratnākara of Nandana).

Kṣitīśavaṃśāvalīcarita
a chronicle of the family of Rāja Kṛṣṇacandra of Navadvīpa, Bengal (from 1077 to 1728 A. D.). Weber 567.
Ed.. an. transl. by W. Pertsch, 1852.
See also Viśvabhāratī Quarterly Vol. XXXI. i. p.. 52-8.

Kṣiyāka
poet. Skm. p. 226.
C.. Khiyāka or Khipāka of Subhāṣitaratnakośa.

Bud. by Jñānavajra. Cordier II. p. 348.

Kṣīṇajihvendriyacikitsāvidhiprotphullapadmanāma
Bud. by Jñānavajra. Cordier II. p. 349.

Kṣīṇanāsendriyarogacikitsā_Nirmaladhundhananāma
Bud. by Jñānavajra. Cordier II. p. 348.

Kṣīṇaśarīrendriyaśarīrarogacikitsāvidhi_Vajrasattvanāma
Bud. by Jñānavajra. Cordier II. p. 349.

Kṣīṇasattvāyurdīrghīkaraṇasiddhividhi_Hiraṇyapadmasiddhināma
Bud. by Jñānavajra. Cordier II. p. 349. [Page151-b]

Kṣīṇāyurdīrghīkaraṇavidhi_Dhārācakranāma
Bud. by Jñānavajra. Cordier II. p. 349.

Kṣīra
teacher in gr. of King Jayāpīḍa of Kashmir, 752-783 A. D.; mentioned in Rājataraṅgiṇī

Kṣīra
or kSIrasvAmin of Kashmir; pupil of Bhaṭṭendurāja.
--Abhinavarāghava. play.
Q. in Nāṭyadarpaṇa, GOS. p. 155.

Kṣīrataraṅgiṇī
or dhAtuvRtti on verbal roots. by Kṣīrasvāmin.
Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 30.

.
Edn.. (1) Liebich, Breslau, 1930. (2) Yudhishthira Mimamsak, Ramlal Kapur Trust, Amritsar, 1958.

Kṣīrataraṅgiṇīsaṅketa
a. abridgement of the above.

Kṣīranadīmāhātmya
from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa; on the sanctity of Pālār near Kāñcī.

Kṣīranidhi
Q. by Gopālācārya in his Bhāgavatabhūṣaṇa, RASB.

Kṣīrapāṇi
med. Q. by Nāganātha in Nidānapradīpa,
(fol. 58a); in Bhāvaprakāśa; by Candraṭa in Cikitsākalikāṭīkā,

a. 358a.
Bhāvaprakāśa ref.s to him a. student of Ātreya Punarvasu; hence Kṣīrapāṇi may be same a. Kṣārapāṇi noted above.

Kṣīrasamudravāsimiśra
writer on Prābhākara school of mīm. of the village Tiruppārkaḍal (Kṣīrasamudra) near Kāñcī (?).
--Arthavādādivicāra. mīm.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 386b.
--C.. Bhāṣyadīpa on Śabara's C. Bhāṣya on Mīmāṁsāsūtras. Adyar D.

.
Kṣīrasāgaramiśra ref. to by Somanātha Dīkṣita in his C. on Śāstradīpikā (Adyar D. IX. p. 41) is probably identical with the a. See N. S. Press (1915) edn. p.. 205, 596.

Kṣīrasāgara
alias of Vāmana.
--C. Induprabhā on Gurupīyūṣalaharī of Keśavānandasvāmin.
See NCC.

Kṣīrasāgara_Paṇḍita
See Rāmeśvara, son of Śrīpati, pupil of Govinda (a. of Pīyūṣadhārā).
--C. Cūḍāmaṇi on Hillāja. jy. Peters.

Kṣīrasādhana
Bud. by Jīmūtapaṭala. Cordier II. p. 167.

Kṣīrasindhu
name of C. on Sadācārasmṛti. Baroda 1880.

Kṣīrasvāmin
writer on gr. an. lex.; son of Bhaṭṭa Īśvarasvāmin. Q.s Bhoja's Sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa an. is q. by Maitreyarakṣita (1109 A. D.) in his Dhātupradīpa an. Vardhamāna in his Gaṇaratnamahodadhi (1141 A. D.).
Intro. verse 7 in his Kṣīrataraṅgiṇī ref.s to six C.s of his, in gr.-lex. (ṣaḍvṛttayaḥ kalpitāḥ). [Page152-b]
--C. Amarakośodghāṭana on Amarakośa.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p.. 325b326a.
--Amṛtataraṅgiṇī or Karmayogāmṛtataraṅgiṇī. Q. in a.'s Kṣīrataraṅgiṇī.
See NCC. III. p. 205b.
--[Avyayavṛtti. BORI. D. II. i. 431].
See Nipātāvyayopasargavṛtti below.
--Kṣīrataraṅgiṇī Dhātuvṛtti.
--[Kṣīrasvāmikośa. Probably his C. on Amarakośa].
--Gaṇavṛtti.
See Yudhisthira Mimamsaka's Saṁskṛta Vyākaraṇ Śāstra kā Itihās II. p.. 136-8.
--Nighaṇṭuvṛtti. Mentioned by Devarāja in his C. on Nirukta.
--Nipātāvyayopasargavṛtti.
Pt.. Tirupati.

Kṣīrasvāmin
or kSIra
--Abhinavarāghava. drama. Q. in Nāṭyadarpaṇa,

. Radh 10.
Evidently his C. on Amarakośa.

Kṣīrasvāmigrantha
dh. (?) Q. in Acala's Nirṇayadīpaka.

Kṣīrasvāmidatta(carakavārttikakāra)
mentioned in Āyurvedadīpikā of Cakrapāṇidatta (p. 434 Carakasaṁhitā. N. S. Press edn. 1941).

Kṣīrābdhidvādaśīvratakathā
from Viṣṇudharmottara.
Pt.. (1) Vratacūḍāmaṇi 1912. (2) with Telugu meaning in Telugu script. Masulipatam, 1915. 1926. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1400. [Page153-a.

Kṣīrābdhiyajanamāhātmya
Pt.. with Telugu meaning in Telugu script. Madras, 1859. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1401.

/2. 966/1. 1902.
--from the Brahmakaivartapurāṇa.
Pt.. in Telugu script. with Telugu meaning. Madras, 1919. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1401.
--from Viṣṇudharmottara.
Pt.. in Telugu script. with Telugu meaning. Vizagapatam, 1917. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1400.

Kṣīrābdhiśayanavratakalpa
Pt.. in Telugu script. Rajahmundry, 1916.

Kṣīrārṇava
śilpa. in more than 100 chs. in the form of dialogue between Viśvakarman an. Nārada; ascribed to Viśvakarman.
(without beg.; with Gujarati explanation in some places).

(iii). 189 (ii). Peters. IV. p. 32 (no. 835). Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 38. Udaipur p. 32, no. 606 of Pt.. Cat. Ujjain I. p. 49.
See also Aparājitapṛcchā, NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 246a.

Kṣīriṇīvanamāhātmya
from Brahmapurāṇa, Uparibhāga, Kṣetrakhaṇḍa; on the sanctity of the place called Tiruppālaitturai.

Kṣīriṇīvanamāhātmya
(the place glorified is mentioned here a. Tiruvāduturai in Tanjore D..) assigned to Brahmottarakhaṇḍa of Skandapurāṇa. Mack 69.

Kṣīrodānīpūjāṣṭaka
Jain. by Abhayacandra.
See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XIII. i. p. 35.
